omission_guidance.summary: NIKL permits optional omission of copular 이 after a vowel-final nominal and explicitly illustrates honorific omission. Applying that boundary rule to the separately documented 겠/더 attachment is an implementation inference.
NIKL distinguishes omission from contraction before 에요/었 and notes that adnominal/nominalizing omission is generally unavailable. This batch adds no bare 던/더라는 omission rule.

remaining: Bare adnominal 던 and 더라는 omission remain outside this batch; no blanket omitted-copula rule for arbitrary endings. Existing nominalization/modal/honorific compositions retain their prior boundaries.
Unclassified lexical heads remain hypotheses. Dictionary presence does not choose the nominal or lexical predicate sense.

Existing prefinal/endings still require a wider attachment review. For example this report probes 의사더다 without certifying the underlying 더 + 다 license; the same issue exists for explicit copulas and lexical predicates.
Independent Korean-language review, fresh passages, performance/ambiguity evaluation and remaining inventory dispositions are pending.
